source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly refuses immediate execution but invents `board-level I2C connection / continuity` and a future bus/address probe even though neither the source target nor operation is defined.

original_test_intent.purpose: Unknown beyond a cable-related item grouped under the I2C test set. The source does not define whether it validates assembly, continuity, endpoint presence, bus communication, signal quality or another behavior.
original_test_intent.target: Unknown. No cable part number, endpoints, connector pins, board revision, I2C controller/bus/address or device is identified.
original_test_intent.scope: Undefined. The 2-minute attended and 2-minute machine estimates are source facts but cannot determine a physical, electrical or software test scope.
original_test_intent.operation: Undefined because Procedure is `TBD`. No cable manipulation, continuity measurement, bus scan, device read, signal capture or power action can be selected safely.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook records 2 attended and 2 machine minutes; active duration and iterations are undefined and cannot be inferred from those estimates.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Undefined because Criteria is `TBD`; cable appearance, continuity, ACK, register value, waveform or error-free traffic are materially different possible outcomes and none is authorized.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Undefined until the owner chooses the test type. A valid definition must identify the exact cable/endpoints/platform, operation, power state, equipment or command, measurable expected result, iteration/timing and safety/recovery evidence.
ambiguities: The cable and both endpoints are unidentified.
Physical inspection, resistance/continuity, powered I2C communication, endpoint enumeration and signal-integrity analysis are all plausible but non-equivalent interpretations.
No bus/address/register, measurement instrument, pin map, power state, expected response or pass limit exists.
No manual-versus-automated boundary or recovery behavior is defined.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly refuses execution and acknowledges that the source could be a BMC-console probe or physical continuity inspection. Under V3, that acknowledged fork is precisely a genuine semantic blocker: the alternatives have different targets, hazards, tools, evidence and capability classes, so provider input is not merely a missing parameter to an otherwise known operation.

applicable_history.decision: V2 preserves the unresolved source but labels it REQUIRES. No later user ruling defines the cable or selects one of the materially different operation types.
The prior I2C `BMC_BD` case establishes the V3 boundary: when the source defers all operation semantics and a scan would be invented, classification remains BLOCKED until the owner defines the test.
BLOCKED applies when a safe deterministic operation and acceptance criterion cannot be defined; plausible physical continuity and powered I2C checks must not be merged.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify from REQUIRES to BLOCKED. The source does not merely omit an obtainable address or tool; it omits the target, operation and acceptance semantics, and several materially different test types remain plausible. No executable revision is safe until the owner provides one complete definition.

available_now: The unique source key, I2C test-set association, generic `Cable` item, 2/2-minute estimates and explicit TBD procedure/criteria are known.
Non-invasive documentation intake, SUT/board identity capture and untouched cable/connector photographs can be prepared without selecting a test interpretation.
missing_inputs: The hardware/platform owner must identify the exact board revision, cable part number, source and destination connectors/pins and intended function.
The test owner must choose one operation type and supply its exact sequence, power state, tools/commands/instruments, parameters, duration/iterations, measurable criteria and evidence.
The safety owner must define authorization, isolation, stop and recovery requirements appropriate to the selected operation.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The hardware/platform and testcase owners must jointly issue the target and test definition; the lab/safety owner supplies method-specific controls only after that definition exists.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record source provenance, SUT/board/BMC/firmware identity and collect approved drawings, BOM or owner documents without probing hardware.
Photograph the untouched labeled cable and endpoints only if safe physical access is already authorized; label the evidence as inventory, not testcase execution.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not infer continuity, scan an I2C bus, read/write any address/register, move/disconnect a cable, apply power/voltage, probe pins, attach an analyzer, choose acceptance values, reuse a neighboring case or claim PASS/FAIL.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Receive one signed definition that resolves target, operation, power state, method, parameters, timing/iterations, criteria, evidence, safety and recovery; verify it against the exact source key and then perform a fresh capability/readiness review before authorizing execution.

revision_candidate.purpose: No executable purpose may be asserted beyond resolving the owner-defined cable-related I2C validation for this exact source row.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Not defined. The owner must identify the exact board revision, cable assembly, endpoints, controller/device context and power state before a platform can be declared applicable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Not defined. Do not substitute a generic I2C bus, visible cable or adjacent testcase. Preserve the 2-minute attended and 2-minute machine values only as unvalidated planning estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed source-to-hardware mapping; cable part and endpoint/pin map; intended function; one selected physical/electrical/protocol operation; power/isolation state; approved tool/command/instrument and parameters; duration/iterations; measurable expected result/tolerance; evidence; operator/automation boundary; authorization; stop and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Do not execute a testcase. Collect only non-invasive definition inputs and route them for owner approval. After one complete operation and criterion are supplied, create a new source-preserving execution contract and reclassify capability; do not append both continuity and bus-probe alternatives to one procedure.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Source row and platform identity are traceable; owner has supplied and approved a single deterministic target, procedure, criterion, safety boundary and recovery path; a new review confirms that the selected method does not contradict the original test intent.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: For definition closure: signed owner clarification, exact cable/endpoints/platform, selected test type, complete procedure and acceptance table, required fixtures/tools, timing/iterations, safety/authorization and recovery. Execution evidence is intentionally undefined until then.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: None currently exists. Procedure and Criteria are both `TBD`; the workbook title and I2C grouping are not an acceptance specification.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No cable manipulation, continuity/resistance test, powered probe, bus enumeration, register access, voltage injection, analyzer connection or power transition is authorized. Preserve private drawings and credentials and do not infer semantics from neighboring rows.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The hardware/platform and testcase owners must approve the completed definition. Method-specific physical or powered-operation approval is required later and cannot be pre-authorized while the method is unknown.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Unknown. The final definition determines whether acceptance is physical/visual, instrumented, software-driven or hybrid; do not assign manual or agent steps yet.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No test action should occur. If an unauthorized probe/manipulation already occurred, stop, preserve the untouched/current state and available BMC/console/physical evidence, do not retry or write the bus and escalate to the platform owner for a method-specific recovery decision.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any attempt to execute while target, operation or criterion remains undefined; guessed cable/endpoints/bus/address/pins; unapproved physical/electrical/powered access; mixed alternative procedures; borrowed neighboring-case semantics; or any proposed PASS/FAIL from inventory alone.

identified_defects: The source provides no target, operation or acceptance criterion.
DeepSeek invents a board-level continuity concept and future I2C bus/address probe from only the test-set label.
V2 recognizes two materially different possible tests but keeps REQUIRES instead of applying the V3 genuine-semantic-blocker boundary.
The 2/2-minute estimates cannot distinguish or define any of the plausible operations.
reason_for_change: Prevent an agent from converting a wholly undefined cable item into a guessed I2C scan, register read or physical continuity operation with incompatible hazards and acceptance evidence.
